author: live_exploration_classical_early
scope: Independent bounded source review of live-state and model-boundary changes in ICA, Manifold, NMF, GMM and Cross-Validation; not a fresh numerical or visual audit of all22 early topics.

findings.description: Nested and halving experiments caught draft calculation failures but recomputed unguarded from the same current inputs. Author changed Fold/Nested/Halving to derive one applied calculation inside try/catch, with descriptions and diagrams conditional on it; source rechecked.
Nested and halving investigation questions still requested guesses. Author replaced these with direct exploration language; source rechecked.

observations: ICA and Manifold update valid active state directly, retain last valid output for invalid drafts with an explicit status and support undo/reset. No effect-based calculation loop.

NMF contribution masks compare the current mask against the fixed full reconstruction on the same image. Changing image restores its complete mask. NMF update edits restart the actual factor trace; zero-row/column restrictions remain explicit.
GMM edited observations and initialization recompute responsibilities and restart the real E/M trace. Separate expectation/maximization buttons are algorithm operations, not answer gates.
Cross-validation retains model predictions and protected-row roles. Guarded calculation failures suppress their views rather than publish an invalid result.
